title: Independently audit every P112 contact phase and dirty-helper word
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR4204’s earlier independent receipt review explicitly left full512-character phase re-enumeration open. This adds a code-disjoint projector/phase implementation for all8880 serialized operators and every5824 published isolated contact on512characters, bothsigns and all3 arbitrary dirty raw-input columns. It binds all57,512 actual plus-one typed operations; minus-sign checks execute the specified word, not the original author controller.

A separately frozen free-group-ring oracle verifies the underlying dirty-helper identity for arbitrary invertible noncommuting frames. Exact2x2 controls catch inverse-order faults that scalar-only tests miss. Four actual character witnesses detect phase/return/precompensation/delivery faults; a separate source/receipt integrator authenticates both frozen implementations and rejects corrupted copies.

Scope: provided geometry and isolated contacts only. No fresh O-column/partner-map or original supplier-port derivation, all-edge compiler lowering, Laurent B4/DP, shared caller, physical invoice, supplier/theorem/kappa, human or formal-kernel acceptance. Formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to stdlib mechanical/written verification. No selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

`formal-interface-lemma`, scope key `dc60a66a8a50aba3e1fb`; scope **changed** from proof-assistant formalization to the explicitly un-replayed stdlib/written phase implication. Nearest work is [PR4204](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4204) and [James Reed’s scoped audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4204#issuecomment-6293939468); this supplies its named full-character gap without expanding the construction.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4204#issuecomment-6296456602 . Canonical main12fa8c5c/priority7 refreshed before submission;326 open/draft bodies and live parent/hub checked, broader overlap partial. Maintainer edits disabled. No merge requested.

## Validation

Validation: six normal/optimized registered Python3.12 stdlib commands; exact committed Git-free and public-head cold replay, source-history bindings and hosted registered verification are recorded in the Discussion handoff. `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-character-contact-audit`.

## Credit

Credit Ross Richardson/PR4204 for original construction, word, proof and phase checks; retained PR425/433/523/531/kernel92/NOTICE lineage; James Reed/rcfc-jreed for the prior aggregate audit and named gap. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex implementation, separately frozen oracle, integration and proof/code review assistance. Apache-2.0; minimal unchanged proof/NOTICE/license/data exports retain origin pins.

## Open next questions

[Package next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e0178f0f0494e3cd2ec467d0e00a395c488c4c69/research/p112-character-contact-audit/README.md#open-next-questions): separately bind one actual all-edge compiler or shared chronological caller to these isolated identities, with complete restoration/layout/precision/paid-work obligations. Those implementation and compatibility premises remain blockers to supplier admission.
## Change and mathematical scope

State the result, changed hypotheses and status: construction, proof, bounded
search, audit or tooling. Distinguish a scalar saving from a paid-profile or κ
improvement. List remaining obligations.

## Task and overlap

Give the base commit, exact dependency heads, concrete object and bounded domain.
For donated-agent work, include the task ID/scope key or link the task card from
autoresearch.md. Link the nearest overlapping PRs and explain the added value;
different random seeds alone are not separate contributions.

Declare whether scope is unchanged, refined or changed. If the card's premise
changed, explain why and how the actual result connects to the bottleneck.

## Validation

Give reproduction commands, environment, exact evidence and meaningful failure
controls. Distinguish finite tests from proof arguments and list checks not run.
For a proposed bound, include the full paid budget and source bindings.

## Credit

Credit predecessor and parallel work, retain source licenses, and disclose
substantial AI assistance. Useful independent or superseded work still merits credit.

## Open next questions

For a research package, link its next questions and give the smallest useful
follow-up, why it matters and any blocker. “None justified” is acceptable.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

What helped, what caused friction or an unintended detour, and one suggested
improvement? A link to the feedback discussion or an existing report is enough.
